adaptation_note: Pi's playbook is unified docs + capability clarity + native device features. This catalog documents Random Timer capabilities for humans and AI agents — not Pi Browser APIs.

developer_journey.title: Get started
developer_journey.summary: Clone repo, read CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, confirm gh auth, run make verify primitives.

developer_journey.title: Local build
developer_journey.summary: Build Android debug APK and iOS scheme; use Makefile targets and platform docs.

developer_journey.title: Integrate capabilities
developer_journey.summary: Timer modes, local storage, Pro entitlements, analytics, share — see capabilities[] below.

developer_journey.title: Store launch
developer_journey.summary: Fastlane metadata, release notes, native-release workflow, store read-back evidence.

capabilities.name: Random interval timer
capabilities.summary: Fires a cue at an unpredictable moment inside a user-selected min/max window; loop and hidden countdown supported.

capabilities.name: Local storage (device preferences)
capabilities.summary: Preferences and session state stay on-device (DataStore/SharedPreferences; UserDefaults). Not a cross-device sync backend — reduces infra cost like Pi local storage guidance.

capabilities.name: Native share
capabilities.summary: iOS ShareSheet wrapper exists for UIActivityViewController. Not yet wired into product UI; Android Intent.ACTION_SEND share helper not present. High-ROI follow-up: share store link / session summary via OS share sheet.

capabilities.name: Pro entitlements (StoreKit / Play)
capabilities.summary: Paid Pro unlocks via App Store / Play. Treat paywall_purchase_success as telemetry, not ledger revenue.

capabilities.name: Product analytics (PostHog)
capabilities.summary: North Star WQTU from timer_completed; paywall funnel events. Query live PostHog before product prioritization.

capabilities.name: AI coach / alarm audio
capabilities.summary: Alarm sounds and optional voice callouts for reaction drills.

capabilities.name: Background timer reliability
capabilities.summary: iOS Live Activities / notifications; Android foreground service + notification controls.

capabilities.name: Store publishing automation
capabilities.summary: Fastlane metadata, CI native-release, evidence-first readiness checks.

ai_guidance.auth_and_payments: Use StoreKit / Play Billing clients in-tree. Never invent catalog SKUs. Prefer live Play/ASC API read-back before claiming purchase readiness.
ai_guidance.documentation_rule: Prefer docs/DEVELOPERS.md over scavenging overlapping guides. If docs disagree with code, trust code + fix the hub.
